externalTrustDisposition: Blocked until an evaluator-owned trust anchor pins this document digest, the dispatch issuer keys, and an out-of-workspace Git binary digest.
isolatedExecutorDisposition: Blocked until an evaluator injects a default-deny filesystem and network isolated check executor; candidate CLI execution remains disabled.
artifactSinkDisposition: Blocked until the same evaluator trust policy attests exclusive access and stable ancestry for the exact evidence artifact sink; capture refuses to run without that sink authority.
migrationRule: The baseline check set remains present; named feature checks extend it without weakening behavior-bearing assertions.
productionDryRunDisposition: Retained in the aggregate and controller-guarded as an explicitly non-mutating bundle operation.
